prompt_en: Create a natural vertical smartphone selfie of the same fictional 18-year-old Korean high-school senior shown in the attached reference image, inside a sunlit Korean classroom after class. She is the universally admired standout beauty of the entire province, with the reference's long straight dark hair, airy bangs, clear warm skin, large brown eyes, softly glossy pink lips, and neat navy blazer, white shirt, and plaid ribbon bow. She holds her smartphone at arm's length and takes a selfie, slightly above eye level, meeting the lens with a small effortless smile. Use a close vertical smartphone frame from mid-torso upward; desks, a green chalkboard, stacked books, and empty chairs recede naturally behind her. Let her extended forearm create mild foreshortening along the lower edge, while a pale rectangle of window light pools across one shoulder and the nearest desktop, visually tying her to the room. Keep her eyes crisp as the farthest desks soften with authentic small-sensor depth. Favor believable handheld perspective, realistic skin detail, subtle phone-camera texture, and a candid everyday mood.
